entity_raw.definition_raw: Resolve SubdomainSource Advanced Player's Guide pg. 1Associated Domain(s): StrengthAssociated Deities: Abhoth, Alocer, Arlachramas, Ashukharma, Baphomet, Bohga, Cayden Cailean, Cihua Couatl, Dranngvit, Falayna, Geryon, Gorum, Haagenti, Iapholi, Imbrex, Irori, Kols, Kurgess, Lanishra, Marishi, Minderhal, Myr, Nameleses, Neshen, Ondisso, Ruapceras, Sobek, Trudd, Urazra, Uruskreil, Yamatsumi, ZevgavizebReplacement Power: The following granted power replaces the might of the gods power of the Strength domain. Bestow Resolve (Su): At 8th level, you can bless creatures with the boldness of your deity. You can bestow a number of temporary hit points equal to your level + your Wisdom modifier to all allies within 20 feet. The temporary hit points remain for 1 minute. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, plus one additional time per day for every 4 levels you possess beyond 8th.Replacement Domain Spells: 1st—bless, 6th—heroes’ feast.
